decision: Existing accepted supervision is materially recoverable; several item tasks have support. Training has not started because execution runtime and production-input gates are not satisfied.
first_fixed_contextual_candidate: technology role, retaining all four original classes

not_supported_as_complete_original_label.entry_scope: Several classes have insufficient final support
not_supported_as_complete_original_label.responsibility_subject_and_relation: Other-person/employer classes and conditional duty have insufficient support

support_gate_not_quality: Train50/final50 only establishes minimum support. No semantic model field is qualified by these counts.
boundaries: All original classes remain; no rare-class dropping or merging to pass.
Same-original-item fields have genuine bindings; atomic entity-pair argument spans and explicit no-relation supervision are not present.
Reference quote conditioned item classification is possible but is an oracle input unless the same candidates can be generated from frozen old outputs without reference labels.
Candidate recall, repeated/missing entity localization, end-to-end evaluation and group performance remain unexecuted.
Final split was used in earlier work and is not newly blind; preserve all old exclusions.
Unknowns and isolated contexts unchanged; no new batch070.
This is not completion of all precise semantics or T1-T6 reanalysis.
independent_review: Sol/medium inspected actual public support results and confirmed scope and insufficient classes
runtime_gate: Existing PyTorch module points to py37 libraries but its loaded PATH did not provide python3; no compatible runtime imported or model loaded. Matching interpreter and transformers compatibility remain unverified.
production_input_gate: Not yet validated; do not claim oracle reference quotes are a production candidate generator.
stop_decision: Preserve recovered artifacts. Do not start a model fit until both execution and non-oracle input conditions are genuinely met. No repeated labels, model search, paid API or full-corpus job.
